display_title: The Contract Marriage Has Come to an End

titles_en.title: The Contract Marriage Has Come to an End

titles_native.title: 契約結婚は終わりましたが？

description:
The contract marriage where we decided to live as a cheating couple has ended. I wanted freedom from my family, and he needed my family's background to build a foundation for. Three years later, we successfully completed our contract marriage. All we had to do was stamp the divorce papers. They would be able to enjoy the life they both wanted. 

“How about we start preparing divorce papers now?” 

“What? What do you mean?” 

“Let’s prepare for divorce.” 

“So… what is divorce?” 

No, I think you’re the one who’s crazy. Wherever my contract husband, who had been so kind to me for the past three years, went, all that remained was the Duke, who was full of cold weather and remained in ignorance. You promised to stamp the divorce papers right now!
